key_insight: A unified spatio-temporal token scoring mechanism that evaluates and prunes unimportant video tokens across both space and time, enabling much more efficient video-capable vision-language models without degrading downstream V&L performance.
problem_solved: Reduces computational and memory costs of video VLMs by removing redundant spatial and temporal tokens in a way that is aware of cross-modal (vision–language) objectives — addressing limitations of pruning methods that act only inside the ViT or only inside the LLM.
method: Compute a lightweight, unified importance score for each space–time token that captures its relevance to downstream vision–language tasks (not just unimodal perception).
Dynamically prune low-scoring tokens during inference (and optionally training), preserving tokens carrying language-relevant semantics while discarding spatial/temporal redundancy.
Jointly optimize the scorer with VLM objectives to maintain cross-modal alignment and task performance after pruning.
impact: Makes video-capable VLMs far more practical by cutting inference cost and latency, enabling longer video inputs and deployment in resource-constrained settings while keeping vision-language capabilities intact.
